findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_preview, grade_form, search, fetch, convert_pdf_preview, create_form_from_pdf, discard_form · Private data: preview_volunteer_form, get_preview, grade_form, search, fetch, convert_pdf_preview, list_forms, get_form, list_applications, get_application, update_application_status, create_form_from_pdf, create_form, update_form, discard_form, publish_form, claim_preview · Public sink: preview_volunteer_form, grade_form, fetch, create_form_from_pdf, create_form, update_form, discard_form, publish_form, claim_preview · Destructive: update_application_status, update_form, discard_form, publish_form.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_preview, grade_form, search, fetch, convert_pdf_preview, create_form_from_pdf, discard_form · Private data: preview_volunteer_form, get_preview, grade_form, search, fetch, convert_pdf_preview, list_forms, get_form, list_applications, get_application, update_application_status, create_form_from_pdf, create_form, update_form, discard_form, publish_form, claim_preview · Public sink: preview_volunteer_form, grade_form, fetch, create_form_from_pdf, create_form, update_form, discard_form, publish_form, claim_preview · Destructive: update_application_status, update_form, discard_form, publish_form

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
